# ServiceNow Kafka Connector
> Open-source (Apache-2.0) ServiceNow connectors for Apache Kafka Connect: a keyset-polling Table API source with historical backfill, and a Table API CRUD sink with reporters and a dead letter queue. The open-source alternative to Confluent's proprietary ServiceNow connectors, by OSO.

## Core Documentation
- [Introduction](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/): what the connectors are and when to use each
- [Getting Started](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/getting-started): installation and ServiceNow integration user / OAuth setup
- [Quickstart](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/getting-started/quickstart): docker compose walkthrough with the bundled fake ServiceNow

## Connectors
- [Source Connector](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/connectors/source): ServiceNow to Kafka - backfill plus continuous keyset polling on sys_updated_on and sys_id, multi-table, at-least-once
- [Sink Connector](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/connectors/sink): Kafka to ServiceNow - create/patch/put/delete, per-partition ordering, ambiguous-write policies, reporters, DLQ

## Concepts & Operations
- [Architecture](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/concepts/architecture)
- [ServiceNow to Kafka integration](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/servicenow-kafka-integration): what the Table API can and cannot do, why keyset polling, when the event bridge is needed
- [Delivery Semantics](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/concepts/delivery-semantics): at-least-once, dedup bound, ordering
- [Offsets & Recovery](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/concepts/offsets-and-recovery): cursor tuples, query fingerprints, offset resets
- [Rate Limits](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/concepts/rate-limits): Retry-After, backoff, concurrency caps

## Migration
- [Migrating from Confluent](https://servicenowkafkaconnector.com/migration/confluent): config translation script, zero-loss cutover, verifiable evidence
